stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai police have deployed more than 500 personnel at Mahalaxmi Racecourse for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh’s concert on Friday, November 27, following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Officials further said that Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have also swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three, as per PTI.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Completes 23 Leak Repairs On Key Water Pipelines Between Powai Reservoir And Sahar Within 24-Hour
stories.summary: The civic body repaired 14 leakages in the 1,800 mm and 2,400 mm pipelines by deploying teams inside the pipelines, as external repairs were not technically feasible. stories.title: BMC clears 15-year deal with Raymond to turn Worli jetty into helipad
stories.summary: The BMC standing committee has cleared a 15-year public-private partnership (PPP) agreement with Raymond Ltd to convert a jetty built during the Mumbai Coastal Road project into a DGCA-licensed helipad at Worli. stories.title: Mumbai: Smoking dispute sparks attack on passenger aboard Kasara-CSMT slow local

stories.title: Panvel civic body urges citizens to report child marriages
stories.summary: The Panvel Municipal Corporation organised awareness programmes at Siddhi Kirwale and Kalamboli on Friday to highlight the harmful effects of child marriage and forced marriage and encourage citizens to help prevent these practices.
